learning_outcomes.text: is able to communicate appropriately in foreign language at B2 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) in everyday life, in academic and professional environments
Ability to prepare a description of a process, a diagram, a figure, an instruction and so on
is able to cooperate in international team
has knowledge of grammatical structures and lexical resources needed to communicate in foreign language in terms of general and specialist language related to field of study
is equipped to participate in lectures, seminars and laboratory classes conducted in foreign language

syllabus_topics: Lexis: verbs 'to have', 'to be' in the present tense, numerals up to 1000, polite phrases, greetings, farewells, simple questions (How much does it cost? Who / What is this?), names of days of the week, drinks and groceries, asking for directions, shopping, getting travel information, booking accommodation etc.
Christmas customs in Poland (Christmas or/and Easter).
Grammar: present tense of some verbs, A subject form of nouns .

Language skills: Understanding politeness and simple questions. Active participation in social situations. Attempts to use language in everyday life. Adressing academic teachers. Formal and informal language.

assessment_methods.method: Class attendance, lesson work, homework, final written and spoken exam

assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the subject is 60.0% of the final grade.
